title: Refusal
description: G7. Matrix answers with a typed refusal instead of a degraded answer or a generic connector error. `class` is CLOSED and is what the server switches on; `code` is OPEN and is what an operator reads. A consumer that meets an unknown `code` MUST fall back to the `class`.

class.description: CLOSED. How the SERVER must react: `not_covered` = this layer cannot answer this question at all; `unavailable` = try later; `denied` = policy said no; `incomplete` = something came back but cannot be used for a completeness or exactness claim; `invalid` = the intent was malformed or contradicts the contract; `exhausted` = a budget or ceiling stopped it.

code.description: OPEN. The specific typed state. Every code Matrix can emit is provoked by at least one conformance scenario — an unreachable code is dead vocabulary and fails the provocation matrix.

message.description: One sentence for an operator. MUST NOT name a source, table, column or collection the caller is not cleared to know exists — a refusal that leaks the name of a hidden required layer defeats the point of hiding it.

source_id.description: Only when the caller is already entitled to know this source is in play.

detail.description: Structured, non-sensitive extras for the journal and the operator UI. Never a stack trace, never a statement, never a credential.
